items.exampleEn: The parcel arrived two days late.
Most pizza shops deliver until midnight.
items.exampleZh: 大多數披薩店外送到半夜。

items.exampleEn: The company supplies paper to many schools.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司供應紙張給許多學校。

items.exampleEn: Please sign for this package at the front desk.
items.exampleZh: 請到櫃台簽收這個包裹。

items.exampleEn: The delivery driver called me from outside.
items.exampleZh: 送貨司機在外面打電話給我。

items.exampleEn: The workers put the boxes into a white van.
items.exampleZh: 工人們把箱子放進一輛白色廂型車。

items.exampleEn: Packing always takes longer than I expect.
items.exampleZh: 打包花的時間總是比我預期的久。

items.sentenceEn: The delivery van comes to our office every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 送貨廂型車每天早上都會來我們辦公室。

items.audioEn: Your package will be delivered between nine and noon tomorrow, so someone should stay in the office.
items.audioZh: 你的包裹明天九點到中午之間送達，所以辦公室要有人在。

items.sentenceEn: We need to order more supplies for the office.
items.sentenceZh: 我們得為辦公室再訂一些用品。

items.sentenceEn: Could you help me with the packing this weekend?
items.sentenceZh: 這個週末你可以幫我打包嗎？

items.stemEn: The ____ was too small to hold all the boxes, so we needed two trips.
items.stemZh: 那輛廂型車太小，裝不下所有箱子，所以我們跑了兩趟。

items.stemEn: The post office will ____ the letter by Friday.
items.stemZh: 郵局會在星期五前把信送到。

items.passageEn: Dear Mr. Ortiz, thank you for your order of office supplies. Because the order is large, we will deliver it in two packages. A van will bring the first package on Tuesday and the second on Thursday. Delivery is free for orders over $100. We take great care with packing, so problems are rare. However, if any goods are damaged, please call us within seven days for a full refund.
items.passageZh: Ortiz 先生您好，感謝您訂購辦公用品。因為訂單數量大，我們會分成兩個包裹送達。廂型車星期二會送來第一個包裹，星期四送第二個。訂單滿 100 元免運費。我們打包時非常小心，所以很少出問題。不過，如果有任何商品損壞，請在七天內來電，即可全額退款。

questions.questionZh: 第二個包裹哪一天送到？
如果商品損壞，該怎麼做？

referenceEn: Delivery is free at this store.
rubricZh: 「免費送貨」可寫，例如 free delivery、delivery is free 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 這個包裹太重了，我一個人搬不動。
referenceEn: This parcel is too heavy for me to carry alone.
The parcel is so heavy that I can't carry it by myself.
rubricZh: 「搬不動」可寫，例如 too heavy for me to carry、so heavy that I can't carry it 等
